training: 80 fitting, 20 development. Match the 40k planar protocol, seed initialization and sampling trace. Channel 2 always contains the centre. Validation uses f1 every 2000 steps.
reference: Prior 40k +/-3mm, same 40 observed replication patients, seeds and augmentation settings.
primary: At f3 with augmentation, average of both mirrored mixed-offset models' patient scores minus the symmetric +/-6mm model. This matches total span and mean absolute distance. Average scores, not masks.
secondary: Mirror direction; each setting minus +/-3mm; f3-f1 changes; augmentation interactions; organ Dice. Paired crossed patient-seed bootstrap, 10000 draws, seed 20261119. Exploratory, unadjusted.
proposal_quality: Original test40, f1/f2/f3, single-channel 2D, conventional 2.5D, 3D; native 6-connected boundaries, max directed HD95, organ-equal overall Dice, three paired contrasts.
latency: Single H100, original seed11 20k models, f1, original test40, decoded raw CPU volume to native CPU labels; five dev warmups and three rotated rounds. Tune batching on development data alone. No memory endpoint.
